newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Benefon 1996 profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Benefon 1996 profit seen down.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 33 million markka median forecast for mobile phone manufacturer Benefon Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax:.
(EPS forecasts by nine analysts, profit forecast by eight).
The results are due on January 31 in the morning.
In 1995, Benefon posted a 74 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
For Benefon's full-year 1997 profit, seven of the nine analysts polled gave a median forecast of 46 million markka (mean 49 million) in a 30-75 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were Aros Securities, Carnegie, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Goldman Sachs, Kleinwort Benson, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
